project_type: Next.js 14 App Router + Supabase + Tailwind CSS
test_framework: No test framework configured - validation via next build
verification_instructions: Run `npx next build` in the project root. All pages must compile without type errors.
environment_constraints: COMMON_DEPENDENCIES network mode - npm packages available. No Dockerfile. No test runner configured beyond build.
contribution_requirements: UI in French. Code in English. Tailwind styling (slate, blue, white, rounded-lg, shadow-sm). All pages use 'use client' with createClient() from @/lib/supabase/client. Supabase migrations numbered sequentially. project-health.json must be updated.
key_patterns: Pages: 'use client' + useState/useEffect + createClient() pattern. API routes in src/app/api/ for admin operations (using createAdminClient). Sidebar navigation in src/components/layout/Sidebar.tsx. Encoder drawer is global component in layout.tsx. audit.ts helper pattern for reusable client-side helpers that call API routes. Lucide-react for icons. SearchableSelect component available.
directory_structure: src/app/ - pages (app router), src/components/ - shared components, src/lib/ - utilities and supabase clients, src/data/ - static data files, supabase/migrations/ - SQL migrations (001-023 exist), public/ - does not exist yet (needs creation)
